# 00000000149

**English.** Conjecture: Measure-theoretic entropy of prime orbits: for every irrational α, the entropy of the family of translation-invariant measures on the half-open unit interval generated by the sequence {αp_n} is zero (the "effective complexity" of the sequence is subpolynomial).

**中文。** 猜想：素数轨道的度量熵:对每个无理 α,由序列 {αp_n} 生成的单位半开区间上平移不变测度族的熵为零(序列的"有效复杂度"为次多项式)。
